name: BOHD
summary: BOHD, also known as 4-methyl-2,5-dimethoxy-β-hydroxyphenethylamine or as β-hydroxy-2C-D, is a drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and BOx families. It is the β-hydroxy derivative of 2C-D.
summaryZh: BOHD是一種致幻劑，分子式C11H17NO3，可看做2C-D的β-羥基衍生物。
summaryZhHans: BOHD是一种致幻剂，分子式C11H17NO3，可看做2C-D的β-羟基衍生物。

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known from laboratory work on 2C compounds.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，僅見於 2C 類化合物的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，仅见于 2C 类化合物的实验室研究。

fact.en: It is 2C-D with a hydroxyl group on the side chain. That one change makes the molecule much more water loving, which usually makes it harder for a drug to reach the brain.
fact.zh: 它是在 2C-D 側鏈上加一個羥基的產物。這項改動使分子大幅變得親水，而這通常會讓藥物更難進入大腦。
fact.zhHans: 它是在 2C-D 侧链上加一个羟基的产物。这项改动使分子大幅变得亲水，而这通常会让药物更难进入大脑。
